chapterInfo.content:
11
Yesu hyɛne Yerusalem nkunimdie mu
(Mateo 21.1-9; Luka 19.29-38; Yohane 12.12-16)
1Na wɔbɛnn Yerusalem, Betfage ne Betania a ɛwɔ Ngo Bepɔ ho no, ɔsomaa n’asuafoɔ no mu baanu, 2na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ akuraa a ɛda mo anim no ase. Na moduru hɔ pɛ a, mobɛhunu afunumu ba bi a wɔasa no homa a onipa biara ntenaa ne so da. Monsane no mfa no mmra. 3#Mar 14.14 Na sɛ obi bisa mo sɛ: Adɛn na moreyɛ yei a, monka sɛ: Ne ho hia Awurade; na ntɛm ara ɔbɛma mode no aba ha. 4Na wɔkɔ kɔhunuu afunumu ba no sɛ ɔsa ɛpono ano wɔ mfikyire, abɔntene, na wɔsanee no. 5Na wɔn a wɔgyina hɔ no mu bi see wɔn sɛ: Moresane afunumu ba no ayɛ deɛn? 6Na asuafoɔ no buaa wɔn sɛdeɛ Yesu kaeɛ no, na wɔmaa wɔn kwan.
7Na wɔde afunumu ba no brɛɛ Yesu, na wɔde wɔn ntoma guu ne so; na ɔtenaa ne so. 8Na nnipa bebree de wɔn ntoma sesɛɛ ɔkwan no so, na ebinom twitwaa nnua mman firi mfuo mu de sesɛɛ ɔkwan no so. 9#Dwom 118.25-26 Na wɔn a wɔdi anim ne wɔn a wɔdi akyire teaa mu sɛ:
Hosiana!
Nhyira ne deɛ ɔnam Awurade din mu reba.
10Nhyira ne yɛn agya Dawid ahennie a ɛreba no!
Hosiana wɔ sorosoro!
Borɔdɔma dua no dome
(Mateo 21.12-22; Luka 19.45-48)
11Na ɔhyɛnee Yerusalem kɔɔ asɔrefie. Na ɔhwɛɛ nnoɔma nyinaa, na adeɛ reyɛ asa no, ɔne dummienu no firi kɔɔ Betania. 12Na adeɛ kyeeɛ a wɔfiri Betania reba no, ɛkɔm dee no. 13Na ɔhunuu borɔdɔma bi wɔ akyiri sɛ ahahan wɔ soɔ no, ɔkɔɔ hɔ sɛ ebia ɔbɛhunu biribi wɔ so anaa? Na ɔduruu ho no, wanhunu hwee sɛ ahahan nko ara; ɛfiri sɛ na borɔdɔma berɛ nnuruiɛ. 14#Mar 11.20 Na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ borɔdɔma no sɛ: Obiara renni wo so aba bio da! Na asuafoɔ no teeɛ.
Yesu pam adwadifoɔ firi asɔredan no mu
(Mateo 21.12-17; Luka 19.45-48; Yohane 2.13-22)
15Na wɔduruu Yerusalem. Na ɔkɔhyɛnee asɔrefie no mu no, ɔfitii aseɛ pamm wɔn a wɔtɔn ne wɔn a wɔtɔ adeɛ asɔrefie hɔ; na ɔbutuu sikasesafoɔ apono ne wɔn a wɔtɔn mmorɔnoma nkonnwa, 16na wamma kwan amma obiara ansoa adeɛ amfa asɔrefie hɔ. 17#Yes 56.7; Yer 7.11 Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛe, see wɔn sɛ: Wɔntwerɛɛ sɛ:
Wɔbɛfrɛ me fie asɔrefie ama amanaman nyinaa?
Na mo deɛ, mode ayɛ adwotwafoɔ bɔn.
18Na asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no teeɛ, na wɔhwehwɛɛ sɛdeɛ wɔbɛkum no; nso na wɔsuro no, ɛfiri sɛ na ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ nkurɔfokuo no nyinaa nwanwa. 19Na adeɛ saeɛ no, ɔfirii kurom hɔ.
Borɔdɔma no wuo ne ho adesua
20Na anɔpatutu a wɔretwam no, wɔhunuu sɛ borɔdɔma no awu firi ne nhini ase. 21Na Petro kaee, see no sɛ: Rabi, hwɛ borɔdɔma a wodomee no no awu! 22Na Yesu bua see wɔn sɛ: Monnya Nyankopɔn mu gyidie! 23#Mat 17.20 Na nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, obiara a ɔbɛse bepɔ yi sɛ: Ma wo ho so kɔhwe ɛpo mu, na ɔnnye akyinnyeɛ wɔ n’akoma mu, na ɔbɛgye adi sɛ deɛ ɔreka no bɛba mu no, ɛbɛyɛ hɔ ama no. 24#Mat 7.7; Yoh 14.13 Yei nti, mese mo sɛ: Adeɛ biara a mobɛsrɛ mo mpaebɔ mu no, monnye nni sɛ mobɛnya, na ɛbɛyɛ hɔ ama mo. 25#Mat 5.23 Na sɛ mogyina hɔ rebɔ mpaeɛ, na mowɔ biribi tia obi a, momfa nkyɛ no, na mo Agya a ɔwɔ soro no nso de mo mfomsoɔ akyɛ mo. 26#Mat 6.14-15 [Na sɛ moamfa ankyɛ a, mo agya a ɔwɔ soro no remfa mo mfomsoɔ nkyɛ mo.]#11.26 Tete atwerɛ afoforɔ a wɔgye tomu no bi mfa nkyekyɛmu 26 nka ho.
Yesu tumi ho asɛmmisa
(Mateo 21.23-27; Luka 20.1-8)
27Na wɔbaa Yerusalem bio. Na ɔnenam asɔrefie no, asɔfoɔ mpanin ne Atwerɛfoɔ ne mpanimfoɔ no baa ne nkyɛn, 28na wɔbisaa no sɛ: Tumi bɛn na wode yɛ nnoɔma yi? Anaasɛ hwan na ɔmaa wo tumi sɛ yɛ yeinom? 29Na Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Mɛbisa mo asɛm baako, na mommua me, na mɛkyerɛ mo tumi ko a mede meyɛ yeinom: 30Yohane asubɔ no, ɛfiri soro anaasɛ ɛfiri nnipa? Mommua me! 31Na wɔdwendwenee kekaa wɔn mu sɛ: Sɛ yɛka sɛ ɛfiri soro a, ɔbɛka sɛ: Ɛnneɛ ɛdeɛn nti na moannye no annie? 32Anaasɛ yɛnka sɛ: Ɛfiri nnipa? Na wɔsuro nkurɔfokuo no, ɛfiri sɛ na nnipa nyinaa bu Yohane sɛ ɔyɛ odiyifoɔ ampa. 33Na wɔbua see Yesu sɛ: Yɛnnim. Na Yesu se: Me nso merenka tumi ko a mede meyɛ yeinom menkyerɛ mo.

Na wɔbɛnn Yerusalem, Betfage ne Betania a ɛwɔ Ngo Bepɔ ho no, ɔsomaa n’asuafoɔ no mu baanu, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ akuraa a ɛda mo anim no ase. Na moduru hɔ pɛ a, mobɛhunu afunumu ba bi a wɔasa no homa a onipa biara ntenaa ne so da. Monsane no mfa no mmra. Na sɛ obi bisa mo sɛ: Adɛn na moreyɛ yei a, monka sɛ: Ne ho hia Awurade; na ntɛm ara ɔbɛma mode no aba ha. Na wɔkɔ kɔhunuu afunumu ba no sɛ ɔsa ɛpono ano wɔ mfikyire, abɔntene, na wɔsanee no. Na wɔn a wɔgyina hɔ no mu bi see wɔn sɛ: Moresane afunumu ba no ayɛ deɛn? Na asuafoɔ no buaa wɔn sɛdeɛ Yesu kaeɛ no, na wɔmaa wɔn kwan.
Na wɔde afunumu ba no brɛɛ Yesu, na wɔde wɔn ntoma guu ne so; na ɔtenaa ne so. Na nnipa bebree de wɔn ntoma sesɛɛ ɔkwan no so, na ebinom twitwaa nnua mman firi mfuo mu de sesɛɛ ɔkwan no so. Na wɔn a wɔdi anim ne wɔn a wɔdi akyire teaa mu sɛ:
Hosiana!
Nhyira ne deɛ ɔnam Awurade din mu reba.
Nhyira ne yɛn agya Dawid ahennie a ɛreba no!
Hosiana wɔ sorosoro!


Na ɔhyɛnee Yerusalem kɔɔ asɔrefie. Na ɔhwɛɛ nnoɔma nyinaa, na adeɛ reyɛ asa no, ɔne dummienu no firi kɔɔ Betania. Na adeɛ kyeeɛ a wɔfiri Betania reba no, ɛkɔm dee no. Na ɔhunuu borɔdɔma bi wɔ akyiri sɛ ahahan wɔ soɔ no, ɔkɔɔ hɔ sɛ ebia ɔbɛhunu biribi wɔ so anaa? Na ɔduruu ho no, wanhunu hwee sɛ ahahan nko ara; ɛfiri sɛ na borɔdɔma berɛ nnuruiɛ. Na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ borɔdɔma no sɛ: Obiara renni wo so aba bio da! Na asuafoɔ no teeɛ.


Na wɔduruu Yerusalem. Na ɔkɔhyɛnee asɔrefie no mu no, ɔfitii aseɛ pamm wɔn a wɔtɔn ne wɔn a wɔtɔ adeɛ asɔrefie hɔ; na ɔbutuu sikasesafoɔ apono ne wɔn a wɔtɔn mmorɔnoma nkonnwa, na wamma kwan amma obiara ansoa adeɛ amfa asɔrefie hɔ. Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛe, see wɔn sɛ: Wɔntwerɛɛ sɛ:
Wɔbɛfrɛ me fie asɔrefie ama amanaman nyinaa?
Na mo deɛ, mode ayɛ adwotwafoɔ bɔn.
Na asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no teeɛ, na wɔhwehwɛɛ sɛdeɛ wɔbɛkum no; nso na wɔsuro no, ɛfiri sɛ na ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ nkurɔfokuo no nyinaa nwanwa. Na adeɛ saeɛ no, ɔfirii kurom hɔ.

Na anɔpatutu a wɔretwam no, wɔhunuu sɛ borɔdɔma no awu firi ne nhini ase. Na Petro kaee, see no sɛ: Rabi, hwɛ borɔdɔma a wodomee no no awu! Na Yesu bua see wɔn sɛ: Monnya Nyankopɔn mu gyidie! Na nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, obiara a ɔbɛse bepɔ yi sɛ: Ma wo ho so kɔhwe ɛpo mu, na ɔnnye akyinnyeɛ wɔ n’akoma mu, na ɔbɛgye adi sɛ deɛ ɔreka no bɛba mu no, ɛbɛyɛ hɔ ama no. Yei nti, mese mo sɛ: Adeɛ biara a mobɛsrɛ mo mpaebɔ mu no, monnye nni sɛ mobɛnya, na ɛbɛyɛ hɔ ama mo. Na sɛ mogyina hɔ rebɔ mpaeɛ, na mowɔ biribi tia obi a, momfa nkyɛ no, na mo Agya a ɔwɔ soro no nso de mo mfomsoɔ akyɛ mo. [Na sɛ moamfa ankyɛ a, mo agya a ɔwɔ soro no remfa mo mfomsoɔ nkyɛ mo.]


Na wɔbaa Yerusalem bio. Na ɔnenam asɔrefie no, asɔfoɔ mpanin ne Atwerɛfoɔ ne mpanimfoɔ no baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔbisaa no sɛ: Tumi bɛn na wode yɛ nnoɔma yi? Anaasɛ hwan na ɔmaa wo tumi sɛ yɛ yeinom? Na Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Mɛbisa mo asɛm baako, na mommua me, na mɛkyerɛ mo tumi ko a mede meyɛ yeinom: Yohane asubɔ no, ɛfiri soro anaasɛ ɛfiri nnipa? Mommua me! Na wɔdwendwenee kekaa wɔn mu sɛ: Sɛ yɛka sɛ ɛfiri soro a, ɔbɛka sɛ: Ɛnneɛ ɛdeɛn nti na moannye no annie? Anaasɛ yɛnka sɛ: Ɛfiri nnipa? Na wɔsuro nkurɔfokuo no, ɛfiri sɛ na nnipa nyinaa bu Yohane sɛ ɔyɛ odiyifoɔ ampa. Na wɔbua see Yesu sɛ: Yɛnnim. Na Yesu se: Me nso merenka tumi ko a mede meyɛ yeinom menkyerɛ mo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
